invalidation.invalidation_detail: Reclassify the descending state if the trading-timeframe lower-high/lower-low sequence is disrupted and price sustains acceptance above the short-term moving-average and local resistance cluster.

hard_anchors: Deterministic short-term and long-term structure are both descending, with a coherent lower-high/lower-low sequence and a healthy bear-trend long-term phase.
Price is below the short-, intermediate-, and longer-horizon EMA/SMA references, giving a uniformly negative moving-average hierarchy.
Recent price is near the lower end of the short-horizon ranges and immediately above nearby support; overhead resistance remains close but unresolved.
ATR(5) is below ATR(14), indicating that near-term realized movement has moderated rather than expanded; intermediate volatility remains moderate relative to price.
Latest volume is materially below its 20-session average, and each of the last three sessions showed below-average participation.

Bearish lower-high/lower-low, bearish fair-value-gap, bearish flag, and bearish head-and-shoulders detections point in the same directional direction; deterministic structure analysis reports no conflicts.
event_modifiers: No concrete earnings, macroeconomic, policy, filing, or idiosyncratic event was supplied as dominant for state estimation on the as-of date.
narrative_residual: The research-manager recommendation and its conditional strategy language are excluded from state direction and feature scoring.
Fundamental resilience, RSI commentary, and claims of waning downside momentum are treated as low-weight residual context rather than overrides of the supplied OHLCV structure.
contradictory_signals: Price is support-adjacent and the research context notes an oversold oscillator with a less-negative MACD histogram, which may indicate local downside extension, but neither observation supersedes the aligned descending structure.
Shrinking volume weakens participation confirmation even as price and moving-average structure remain consistently negative.
